items.q: What is CompeteLikePros powered by Soxcessful ®?
a: CompeteLikePros powered by Soxcessful ® is a platform connecting athletes, coaches, and facilities to deliver sports programs (e.g., camps, lessons, leagues) across baseball/softball, basketball, esports, football/soccer, golf, and pickleball. It emphasizes professional training, inclusivity, and community engagement, with a revenue-share model where providers retain 60-70% of gross revenue.

items.q: What is the Local Heroes initiative?
a: Local Heroes is a content creation program that tells authentic stories of local athletes, teams, and communities through videos, articles, podcasts, and photo stories. It aims to build emotional connections and brand loyalty, distributed via social media (X, Instagram, TikTok, YouTube, LinkedIn and other channels).

items.q: Why partner with CompeteLikePros powered by Soxcessful ®?
a: Partners gain exposure through co-branded content, access to a growing platform, opportunities to lead programs (e.g., camps, lessons), and community impact. You’ll also benefit from CompeteLikePros powered by Soxcessful ®’s partnerships with venues, sponsors, and local providers.

items.q: Who can partner?
a: NIL athletes (college athletes leveraging their name, image, likeness), current/ex-pros, and influencers with a sports-related following (5,000-100,000+ followers) are eligible. Partners should align with the platform’s mission of authenticity and community engagement.

items.q: What roles can I play?
a: Roles include brand ambassador, content creator for Local Heroes, guest coach for camps/workshops, meet-and-greets, or merchandise drops and more. You can also nominate local stories or connect with community groups.

items.q: How do I join as a partner?
a: Complete our onboarding questionnaire sent to you. The team reviews submissions, conducts interviews, and verifies background checks ($50, covered by CompeteLikePros). Approved partners sign an agreement outlining roles, earnings, and potential opportunities.

items.q: What is the onboarding timeline?
a: Onboarding takes 2-4 weeks: 1 week for questionnaire review, 1 week for interviews and background checks, and 1-2 weeks for contract signing.

items.q: Do I need a background check?
a: All partners involved in groups or private training may require a $50 background check (covered by CompeteLikePros powered by Soxcessful ® for partners, unlike providers). This ensures safety and compliance.

items.q: Do I need liability insurance?
a: If you plan on running sessions or other activities in person on your own then Yes, a $1M liability insurance will be required. In situations CompeteLikePros powered by Soxcessful ® is the host, our $2M blanket policy supplements or covers this.

items.q: What is expected of me as a partner?
a: Depending on your role, you may create Local Heroes content (e.g., videos, interviews), lead programs (e.g., private lessons, camps), host meet-and-greets, or promote CompeteLikePros powered by Soxcessful ® on social media.

items.q: How much time is required?
a: Time commitment varies: content creation (2-5 hours/month), coaching (5-20 hours/month), events (1-2 days/event). You specify availability during onboarding.

items.q: What are the potential fees for partnerships?
a: Brand Partnerships: Fixed fees of $100 -$25,000+ per campaign for social media posts, content features, or ambassador roles, depending on your follower count and engagement.
Meet-and-Greets: $250 – $10,000 per event (1-2 hours), based on attendance and location (e.g., Travel expenses covered for events outside your primary location.

Brand/Product Development: Development costs (e.g., design, prototyping) may be split 50/50 with CompeteLikePros powered by Soxcessful ®. However, earnings may range from $100 – $100,000+ for various projects.

Content Creation (Local Heroes): With no upfront cost to you; CompeteLikePros covers production, and you earn a 25% revenue on your branded merchandise shipped directly to customers and $100-$15,000 per appearance fee for events. Coaching/Programs: 60-70% revenue share (same as providers) for leading lessons, camps, or workshops, with CompeteLikePros taking 30-40%. Example: $150 private lesson yields $90-$105 for you.

items.q: Are there costs I need to cover?
a: You cover your $1M liability insurance (est. $500-$1,000/year) and any travel expenses not pre-approved for events. Content production and background checks are covered by CompeteLikePros powered by Soxcessful ®.

items.q: How are payments handled?
a: Payments are processed via Stripe, bank transfers or checks, with revenue shares or fixed fees disbursed monthly. Transparent dashboards track earnings from bookings and merchandise.

items.q: How do I contribute to Local Heroes?
a: Share your story or nominate local athletes/teams. Participate in interviews, filming, or podcasts (2-5 hours per story). Content is produced by CompeteLikePros’ team of photographers, videographers, and editors.

items.q: What types of content will I be featured in?
a: You may appear in short videos (1-3 minutes), long-form documentaries (5-10 minutes), photo stories, articles (300-500 words), or podcasts (15-20 minutes), distributed on X, Instagram, TikTok, YouTube, LinkedIn, and the app/website.

items.q: Can I promote my own brand in Local Heroes content?
a: Yes, co-branding is encouraged (e.g., your logo alongside CompeteLikePros powered by Soxcessful ®), limited to 20% of visual space. Approval ensures alignment with brand guidelines.

a: Absolutely. You can promote camps, lessons, or events to your followers.

a: Yes, partners are expected to share co-branded content (e.g., Local Heroes videos, event teasers) on their social channels (1-2 posts/month). Templates and assets are provided for ease.

a: Yes, you can lead private lessons, group lessons, camps, or workshops, retaining 60-70% of revenue. You’ll use the app/website for scheduling and bookings, with 30% customization allowed for your coaching style.

a: Your name/image/logo can appear on content, merchandise, or programs (e.g., “[Your Name]’s Elite Camp powered by CompeteLikePros”). Co-branding is subject to approval to ensure CompeteLikePros powered by Soxcessful ® prominence.

items.q: What are the benefits of co-branding?
a: Increase your brand visibility, leverage CompeteLikePros’ global partners and sponsors, and reach new audiences through co-branded campaigns and events.

items.q: How is my data used?
a: Your profile, social media metrics, and program performance (e.g., coaching hours, bookings) are tracked via the app/website to optimize partnerships and measure ROI. Anonymized engagement data may be shared with sponsors.

items.q: Is my data secure?
a: Yes, CompeteLikePros powered by Soxcessful ® uses GDPR-compliant, secure storage for all partner data. Personal information is only shared with your consent (e.g., for co-branded content).

items.q: What if I have conflicts with other partnerships?
a: Disclose existing partnerships during onboarding. CompeteLikePros will work to avoid conflicts or negotiate non-exclusive terms with sponsors (e.g., allowing both Nike and Adidas affiliations).

a: CompeteLikePros powered by Soxcessful ® offers flexible roles to match your availability. If performance issues arise (e.g., low engagement), the team provides feedback and support. Persistent underperformance may lead to contract review.

items.q: What do you offer facilities or clubs?

• Access to professional and collegiate-level partners (coaches, trainers, nutritionists)
• Exposure through CLP content, media, and athlete spotlights
• Opportunities to monetize your space while enhancing value for your athletes
• Co-branded merchandise, digital content, or team stories

items.q: Do you charge clubs/facilities to partner?

items.q: Do we need to shut down operations during a CLP activation?

items.q: Who handles athlete waivers or parental consent for media?
a: CLP provides branded consent forms for any content capture. If your club already has a media waiver, we can adapt to your policies or combine legal coverage as needed.

items.q: Can our coaches and staff be involved or featured?
a: Absolutely. We want your team involved. We can spotlight coaches in training segments, tutorials, interviews, or co-branded coaching education.

items.q: Can you help promote our club, facility, or events?
a: Yes. As a CLP partner, you’ll be listed in our network, tagged in relevant media, and considered for special exposure such as “Facility of the Month,” email features, or national brand collabs.

items.q: Do we need special equipment or setup?
a: No. We bring everything needed to shoot, stream, or activate. If you already have tech or gear, great—we’ll optimize your setup.

items.q: Can we host multiple activations per year?
a: Yes. Many partners collaborate with us quarterly or seasonally. We’ll create a roadmap that fits your training calendar and athlete needs.

items.q: How do we get started?
a: Fill out the onboarding form. Once reviewed, we’ll contact you to schedule a discovery call. From there, we’ll build a partnership plan that matches your goals and community impact strategy.

items.q: What do you expect from us?
a: Openness, communication, and collaboration. We’re not asking for your space—we’re asking to build something in it with you. If you believe in supporting athletes beyond just performance, we’ll work well together.

items.q: What is CLP and how can it support our league or club?
a: CLP is a performance-driven platform offering on-the-ground content, activations, and branded partnerships that meet athletes, teams, and sports communities where they are. We help amplify your league, spotlight your participants, and enhance your brand’s visibility with elite-level creative and support.

items.q: What types of leagues or clubs do you work with?
a: We work with:
• Youth sports leagues (rec and elite)
• High school or AAU-level competition
• College club leagues
• Adult rec leagues and competitive city leagues
• Social or fitness-based sports communities
If you gather people to play and build culture, we want to collaborate.

items.q: What does a partnership look like in practice?
a: We might:
• Produce highlight reels of your top games or seasons
• Interview or feature your standout players or teams
• Host pop-ups with gear try-ons and giveaways
• Run “train like a pro” workshops with coaches or trainers
• Help co-promote your league through social media collabs
• Deliver NIL support or media training for athletes
We’re flexible to what adds value to your players and brand.

items.q: Do we need to pay for these services?
a: No — we work through sponsorships, merchandise, and co-branded campaigns so there’s no upfront cost for the league. We may share revenue or collaborate on fundraising where needed.

items.q: What if our athletes are youth — are there media consent concerns?
a: Yes — and we take that seriously. We provide all required forms and work with you to ensure that only athletes with approved media consent are featured. No footage is published without verification.

items.q: Can CLP help promote our team/league or grow registration?
a: Absolutely. Through videos, reels, testimonials, and activation coverage, we create compelling content that leagues can use to drive interest and recruit more players or partners.

items.q: Can we do one event or pop-up first before a full partnership?
a: Yes! We often start with a single showcase, try-on day, or highlight shoot and grow the partnership organically. No long-term commitments required upfront.

items.q: Can coaches or players get involved with CLP beyond the league?
a: Definitely. We create pathways for standout players or leaders to be featured in content, merch campaigns, interviews, and even work with brands or get training support.

items.q: What are the benefits of partnering with CLP over another brand or videography team?
a: We bring:
• Brand equity (nationally recognized)
• Flexible media teams with mobile capability
• Athlete development at the core — not just content for hype
• A network of nutritionists, trainers, and creators to support your league
• Real tools to grow your community — not just a post and go

items.q: What happens next if we’re interested?
a: Fill out the onboarding form. We’ll review it and schedule a quick intro call. From there, we’ll map out what activation, content, or partnership makes sense for your season or club calendar.

items.q: What if we don’t have our own facility or staff — can we still partner?
a: Yes! Many leagues rent spaces or rely on volunteers. We work around your resources and can even help source partners in your area if needed (e.g., gyms, trainers, brands).

items.q: What is Compete Like Pros (CLP)?
a: CLP is a mobile and digital platform built to elevate athletes through high-performance training, content, experiences, and partnerships. We help athletes—from youth to pros—access the tools, support, and exposure they need to grow.

items.q: What role do sports nutritionists play in CLP?
a: Nutritionists are critical to our holistic approach to athlete development. You’ll help educate, guide, and support athletes in fueling correctly to reach performance goals safely and sustainably—whether through content, consultations, or activations.

items.q: Will I be compensated for my time or appearances?
a: Yes. Compensation is determined per engagement and scope. We offer paid opportunities for live events, content creation, consulting, branded content, or educational programming. No unpaid use of your time or expertise will occur without prior agreement.

items.q: Will I be required to travel?
a: Travel is not required unless explicitly agreed upon. Many opportunities can be done virtually or pre-recorded. For in-person events, we cover travel, accommodations, and meals when applicable, as long as terms are confirmed in advance.

items.q: Can I bring my own products or supplements?
a: Yes, if it aligns with CLP’s health and safety standards. We encourage partners to share trusted tools or products they use with athletes, but we require transparency and proper certifications for anything distributed or promoted.

items.q: Will I have creative input into the content we collaborate on?
a: Absolutely. We want your expertise and voice to shine. You’ll approve any final versions of video, quotes, articles, or guides before publication. We’ll collaborate on structure, tone, and delivery to make sure it represents you well.

items.q: What type of athletes will I be working with?
a: Our athlete community includes youth (ages 8+), high school teams, college players, and sometimes professionals. Based on your experience, we’ll align you with the best fit—whether that’s young athletes, elite performers, or their parents/coaches.

items.q: Do I need to be licensed or certified to partner with CLP?
a: Yes. You must have relevant certifications, credentials, or verifiable experience in sports nutrition, dietetics, or performance fueling. We prioritize RDs, CNSs, or performance nutritionists with youth or team experience.

items.q: Will CLP promote my personal brand or business?
a: Yes, where relevant. We highlight our expert partners through co-branded content, spotlights, and social features. We’re happy to promote your consulting services, speaking engagements, and public events—especially if they serve our athlete base.

items.q: How do you handle liability or health disclaimers?
a: We require that all nutrition guidance follows current best practices, is evidence-based, and includes appropriate disclaimers. If working directly with athletes, liability insurance and consent protocols will be discussed before any engagement.

items.q: Can I share CLP content on my own social media or site?
a: Yes. Once we finalize and publish branded content, you’re encouraged to share it across your platforms. We’ll provide copies or co-branded versions of reels, posts, or graphics for your use—with proper credit and tagging.

items.q: What kinds of content do you want from me?
a: Think short, powerful, and athlete-focused:
• Pre-game meal prep ideas
• Recovery snack recommendations
• Hydration tips
• “What’s in my bag” supplement talk
• Myth-busting (e.g., protein timing, sugar, creatine)
• Advice for high-performance school days (especially for teens)
We’re also open to full-length articles, workshop slides, or athlete Q&A sessions.

items.q: Is this a one-time or ongoing partnership?
a: That depends on fit and mutual interest. We offer one-time collaborations (content or event) as well as long-term contributor or brand ambassador roles. Our goal is to build authentic, recurring relationships with experts who care about athlete impact.

items.q: Will I work directly with athletes, or only behind the scenes?
a: Both are possible. You may speak at events, lead virtual Q&As, create content series, or develop guides used by our partner coaches. Based on your goals, we’ll match you with the right format and involvement level.

items.q: What does CLP/Soxcessful® expect from content creators?
a: We expect reliability, professionalism, strong communication, and the ability to tell compelling athlete-first stories in a fast-paced, sports-centric environment. We value creators who can capture energy, motion, personality, and detail across all types of settings.

items.q: Who owns the content we capture?
a: CLP operates under a work-for-hire model — which means all final footage, raw files, and media captured are owned by Compete Like Pros (Powered by Soxcessful®) and our clients/partners unless otherwise agreed in writing. We may still tag and spotlight you for promotion and visibility.

items.q: Can I use the content for my personal portfolio or social media?
a: Yes — once content is published by CLP, we encourage creators to repost and credit it as part of their body of work. Please don’t release unreleased or sensitive content prior to official launch.

items.q: Do I have to attend every event in person?
a: No. Some creators are hired just to edit remotely. Others are on the ground with the team. If you travel with us or attend events, we’ll cover mileage, hotel, or meals based on pre-approved budget and terms.

items.q: What kind of content do you regularly produce?
a: CLP/Soxcessful® content includes:
• Athlete highlight reels
• Game day recaps
• “Train like a pro” sessions
• Gear/product drops
• Social-first mini-docs
• Behind-the-scenes stories
• Interviews and testimonials
• Sponsored content for brand partners

items.q: How fast is the turnaround time?
a: For same-day coverage (event reels, try-on edits), we prefer 6–12 hour turnaround. For recap videos, 48–72 hours is ideal. Longer projects or documentaries will have custom timelines. We’ll always communicate clearly.

items.q: Do I need to show up with a full gear setup?
a: We prefer creators who can bring their own tools (camera, mics, gimbal, SD cards, etc.), but if you’re paired with our team, we may supply extras. Drone pilots must be certified and follow FAA/local regulations.

items.q: Will I be credited publicly?
a: Yes! We tag creators, share BTS, and encourage networking. You’ll also be prioritized for repeat gigs based on consistency and delivery.

items.q: Can I work under my own brand name?
a: Yes. You’re a creator — we respect that. Just know that projects are presented under the CLP/Soxcessful® brand umbrella. We’ll gladly mention or feature your business in select cases (IG, reels, blog write-ups).

items.q: How do I apply or get started?
a: Fill out the onboarding form, send your best work, and we’ll review and follow up with opportunities based on fit, location, and availability.

items.q: What makes a good CLP/Soxcessful® content creator?
a: • Fast but clean editor
• Can work with minimal direction
• Understands sports energy
• Captures emotion and moments
• Respects the athletes, coaches, and brand
• Delivers when it counts

items.q: What is CLP and how do PT & Rehab providers fit in?
a: CLP is a performance and recovery platform that brings high-level training, content, and resources directly to athletes. Physical therapists and rehab partners play a critical role in educating athletes, accelerating recovery, and reducing long-term injury risks. You’re not just a vendor — you’re part of the athlete development ecosystem.

items.q: What does a partnership typically include?

• Educational video content (stretching, recovery tips, injury risk awareness)
• Feature reels of your facility, team, or success stories
• Co-hosted pop-ups or athlete-focused wellness days
• Digital courses or prevention series in partnership with coaches/teams
• Integration into CLP content for rehab storytelling or testimonials

items.q: Will I be compensated?
a: Yes. Payment depends on scope (in-person, virtual, sponsored content, etc.). We also offer bartered services (e.g., media exposure or access to athletes in exchange for activation support) depending on mutual benefit and project type.

items.q: Do I have to be on camera?
a: Not unless you want to. We have multiple partnership models—some involve behind-the-scenes consulting, some are media-forward. Your comfort level defines your visibility.

items.q: What kind of athletes will I be working with?
a: Depending on your expertise, you may be matched with:
• Individual youth or high school athletes
• College or semi-pro players
• Entire teams or clubs needing seasonal support
• Athletes returning from injury or needing prehab tips

items.q: What kind of content would I be expected to create?

• “How to Recover Fast After a Weekend Tournament”
• “Signs You’re Rushing Return to Play”
• “ACL Prevention Protocol for Female Athletes”
We’ll guide you on formats, tone, and how to make it athlete-friendly and short-form where possible.

items.q: Can I promote my clinic or private practice?
a: Absolutely. We believe in supporting our partners. We’ll include co-branding, business tags, or even a spotlight feature about your work. It’s all about authentic collaboration that helps you grow while serving athletes.

items.q: Do I need a facility or can I operate mobile or virtual only?
a: All are welcome. Whether you have a full rehab space, work out of gyms, or provide remote programs — we’re flexible and build partnerships based on your model.

items.q: Can I sponsor recovery zones or on-site support at events?
a: Yes. This is one of our most popular collaboration formats. You provide light service (stretching, taping, activation), and we feature your brand. You may also sponsor product sampling or integrate with one of our training partners.

items.q: Can I collaborate on team-specific rehab protocols or return-to-play education?
a: Yes. We work with teams and leagues that want to implement better injury recovery planning and education. You can be the go-to specialist for that sport or age group.

items.q: Do you offer exclusivity by region or city?
a: For recurring partners and sponsors, yes. If you’re featured heavily in a region, we typically won’t partner with your competitors. We’ll discuss exclusivity rights based on scope and impact.

items.q: Who provides the legal forms, waivers, and release docs?
a: CLP handles the legal side for any media, event, or partnership use. You’ll receive proper consent templates and insurance clarifications based on the event type or activation.

items.q: What’s the first step if I’m interested?
a: Complete the onboarding form, and our partnership team will reach out to schedule a call. From there, we can design a collaboration tailored to your services, goals, and preferred level of involvement.

items.q: What is CLP, and how do coaches fit into it?

items.q: What types of opportunities are available for me?

items.q: Do I get paid for working with CLP?
a: Yes. All activations and partnerships are scoped with clear compensation. Payment varies by content, in-person involvement, or ongoing series work.

items.q: Do I have to travel?
a: Not unless you want to. Some events are local. Others are travel-based and include covered lodging, meals, and compensation. Virtual options are also available.

items.q: Can I keep my coaching brand or facility while working with CLP?
a: Yes. We love to support entrepreneurial coaches. We’ll co-brand where needed and elevate your identity — no exclusivity required unless you’re leading sponsored campaigns.

items.q: What kinds of athletes would I work with?
a: Mostly youth (ages 8–18), high school teams, college athletes, and occasionally pros. We match based on your specialties and age group experience.

items.q: Will I be expected to create social media content?
a: Only if you’re interested. We do offer opportunities for coaches to be featured in tutorials, mindset talks, workout reels, or gear reviews. We’ll collaborate on messaging and visual style.

items.q: Can I recommend my own drills or methodology?
a: 100%. We want your coaching style, cues, and philosophy. We’ll guide the tone and branding, but you drive the substance.

items.q: Is CLP focused on a specific sport?
a: No. We serve multi-sport athletes — base/softball, basketball, eSports, Futbol(soccer), golf, pickleball and more. If you specialize in a specific sport, we’ll connect you with relevant teams or events.

items.q: Can I use CLP footage to market myself?
a: Yes. Once approved, you’re free to repost or share your featured content with proper CLP credit and hashtags. We want you to grow, too.

items.q: Will I have to wear CLP gear or branding?
a: Only at events where we’re producing branded content. Otherwise, you can wear your own or co-branded gear. We’ll send you apparel or discuss wardrobe when needed.

items.q: What’s the difference between CLP and other coaching networks?
a: We’re not a coaching marketplace or directory. CLP is an ecosystem. You’re not just listed — you’re featured, amplified, and embedded in real programming, branded media, and impact events.

items.q: What’s the next step if I want to be involved?
a: Fill out the onboarding questionnaire and our team will review your fit for current or future opportunities. We’ll reach out to schedule a call or invite you to an upcoming activation.

items.q: What if I don’t want to be on camera or in the spotlight?
a: That’s okay. We also need off-camera coaches for program development, athlete screening, private consults, or on-site support.

items.q: What opportunities does CLP offer for athletes to engage with their communities and make a positive impact?

For Parents:

items.q: How does CLP support athletes’ career transitions and post-athletic endeavors?
a: CLP provides guidance and resources to athletes as they transition into post-athletic careers, including education and vocational opportunities, financial planning, and personal development programs.

items.q: What can I expect from CLP as an athlete?
a: CLP is committed to providing comprehensive representation and support for athletes, including contract negotiations, endorsement deals, brand management, career guidance, and access to resources for training and development.

items.q: How does CLP help athletes achieve their goals?
a: CLP works closely with athletes to develop personalized strategies for success, leveraging their network, expertise, and industry insights to create opportunities for growth, recognition, and long-term success in their respective sports.

items.q: What does CLP expect from athletes on and off the field?
a: • Show respect to coaches, teammates, opponents, and officials.
• Bring consistent effort, accountability, and a growth mindset.
• Compete with humility in victory and dignity in defeat.
• Prioritize mental and physical wellness.
• Be a leader, even without the title.
• Take responsibility for preparation and recovery.
• Practice good sportsmanship, win or lose.
• Support team culture and contribute to a positive locker room.
• Stay off social media drama — let performance speak.
• Respect all travel, facility, and equipment guidelines.

items.q: How should athletes respond to mistakes or losses?
a: • Own your errors and bounce back with resilience.
• Focus on learning and growth rather than blame.

items.q: What does leadership look like in a CLP athlete?
a: Supporting teammates, leading by example, and being a positive influence.

items.q: What’s expected when representing CLP during travel or tournaments?
a: Represent the brand with pride, dress appropriately, follow instructions, and respect all accommodations.

items.q: How should athletes manage their time and commitments?
a: Stay organized, communicate proactively, and avoid scheduling conflicts.

items.q: What behavior is not tolerated from athletes?
a: • Bullying, harassment, or discriminatory language
• Cheating, fighting, or unsportsmanlike conduct
• Disrespect toward staff, referees, or other participants

• Dismissive behavior toward teammates or coaching input

items.q: What resources does CLP provide to help parents navigate the complexities of the sports industry and support their child’s development?

items.q: How does CLP ensure transparency and open communication with parents regarding their child’s athletic journey?

items.q: How does CLP ensure the well-being and success of young athletes?
a: CLP prioritizes the holistic development and welfare of young athletes, providing guidance on balancing academics, training, and competitions. They also promote ethical practices, compliance with regulations, and support systems for mental and physical well-being.

items.q: What role does CLP play in my child’s athletic career?
a: CLP serves as a valuable partner for parents, offering professional guidance, mentorship, and advocacy for young athletes. They assist in navigating the complexities of the sports industry, fostering opportunities for skill development, exposure, and advancement.

items.q: What values does CLP encourage parents to model?
a: Positivity, patience, humility, and emotional control during high-pressure moments.

items.q: Can parents volunteer or contribute to team operations?
a: Yes! Reach out to our staff for structured volunteer roles or support opportunities.

items.q: What parent behaviors are unacceptable?
a: • Sideline coaching or undermining coaches’ authority
• Verbal abuse of referees, staff, or players
• Disruptive or disrespectful conduct that impacts team morale
• Confronting athletes, refs, or coaches during/after games
• Gossiping or spreading misinformation within team channels
• Ignoring health or injury protocols
• Pushing your athlete toward burnout or pressure

items.q: What role do fans play at CLP events and why does it matter?
a: • Support all athletes positively and fairly.
• Promote a welcoming, inclusive, and spirited environment.
• Respect officials and coaches regardless of game outcome.
• Applaud hustle, not just highlights.
• Stay off the field/court unless authorized.
• Encourage players from both teams.
• Follow all posted facility and event rules.
• De-escalate conflict or report it to staff.
• Set a positive example for youth athletes.

items.q: What should fans do if they witness inappropriate conduct?
a: Alert a CLP staff member or official immediately.

items.q: Are there rules around photography or video at events?
a: Yes. Always ask permission before filming players, especially minors.

items.q: Can fans bring banners, signs, or instruments?
a: Fan gear is encouraged if positive and non-disruptive. CLP reserves the right to limit items.

items.q: How can fans help uphold the CLP mission?
a: Cheer with class, respect all, and set the tone for community excellence.

items.q: What fan conduct is not allowed?
a: • Hate speech, harassment, or aggressive outbursts
• Intoxication, threats, or disruptive behavior
• Any action that compromises safety or the event experience
• Confronting referees, players, or parents
• Throwing objects or damaging property
• Excessive profanity or inappropriate gestures
• Filming minors or athletes without consent

items.q: What support does CLP provide to operators in terms of talent acquisition, retention, and development?
a: CLP offers talent scouting services, talent management strategies, coach development programs, and access to performance analytics tools to help operators identify, nurture, and retain top talent within their organizations.

items.q: How does CLP collaborate with operators to create innovative and engaging experiences for athletes and fans?
a: CLP works closely with operators to develop and implement creative initiatives, such as fan engagement strategies, digital content platforms, experiential marketing campaigns, and innovative event concepts.

items.q: How does CLP contribute to the success of sports organizations?
a: CLP brings expertise in areas such as event management, talent scouting, marketing, sponsorships, and operational efficiency, helping organizations optimize their resources, attract top talent, engage fans, and achieve their strategic objectives.

items.q: What can operators expect when partnering with CLP?
a: Operators can expect a collaborative partnership with CLP focused on enhancing the overall experience for athletes, coaches, and stakeholders. This includes access to professional services, strategic planning, marketing support, and opportunities for growth and sustainability.

items.q: How do I become an approved operator, and what do I need to do?
a: Before becoming a league, a few steps must be taken. The following is a general outline of what needs to be done:
• Fill out the interest form on our website
• Get in touch with a CLP Experiences representative today
• Submit an official application with additional information, including the location of your operation(s)
• If applicable, provide a plan of action for review
• Conduct a background check and receive SafeSport training
• Provide a Certificate of Insurance in accordance with CLP Experiences standards

items.q: How long is a typical CLP Experiences season?
a: A typical season should run approximately 6 – 12 weeks.

items.q: How much does it cost to become a CLP Experiences operator?
a: Operators of CLP Experiences do not have to pay any up-front fees. After becoming a partner, you pay a fee per trainer and/or participant transaction

Mentors, trainers, and operators are required to undergo background checks and obtain certificates of insurance. Additionally, the organization or business must be in good standing with their local government and maintain it.

items.q: I already run a successful program – why should I join CLP Experiences?
a: Joining CLP Experiences gives our partners access to exclusive discounts and services. Furthermore, you will receive high-quality branded uniforms and equipment, along with a suite of operational resources.

items.q: Who do you partner with?
a: Partner operators who share our mission of increasing physical activity and wellness are welcome to participate in our programs.

items.q: What are CLP’s expectations for partners involved in our programs and events?
a: • Act with professionalism, reliability, and safety-first awareness.
• Elevate the athlete and family experience.
• Operate transparently and honor commitments.
• Support inclusion and fair access across all athletes.
• Maintain safe, clean, and accessible environments.
• Communicate delays or issues proactively.
• Be mindful of image rights and privacy concerns.
• Represent your brand with integrity.
• Build trust with teams and families.

items.q: How should partners address safety and liability concerns?
a: All services must follow CLP safety protocols, waivers, and insurance coverage.

items.q: What makes a great CLP partner?
a: Proactive communication, flexibility, ethical conduct, and passion for youth sports.

items.q: Can partners promote their services through CLP?
a: With approval, yes. We offer brand alignment packages and event integration options.

items.q: How are conflicts or complaints handled?
a: Through open dialogue, documentation, and solution-first approaches involving CLP leadership.

items.q: What won’t CLP tolerate from partners?
a: • Conflicts of interest, misrepresentation, or dishonesty
• Unsafe working conditions or service gaps
• Any behavior that risks brand integrity or athlete trust
• Exploitative media or commercial activity
• Failure to follow safety, waiver, or content guidelines
• Ignoring legal, insurance, or partnership terms
• Disrespect toward event staff, coaches, or guests
• Lack of support for diversity or inclusion principles
